meta.title: Pricing - one offer, 4,800 € a year
meta.description: The guided pass through every NIS 2 duty: 4,800 € net a year, 30 days money back, export at any time. The source stays open and self-hosting stays free.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: One offer. One price. Thirty days to change your mind, and your data leaves with you whenever you want.

free.name: Hosted on nisd2.eu
free.description: The full pass through your duties, run by us on EU infrastructure.

features.f1: Every duty under § 30 BSIG, one item per screen
features.f2: The BSI's own requirements for each area, with the source
features.f3: Your decision and your reason, with a name and a date
features.f4: A status report as a PDF for auditors and management
features.f5: A complete trail: who decided what, and when
features.f9: Thirty days money back, no reason needed
features.f10: Export at any time, including into self-hosting. No lock-in.

free.vatNote: plus VAT. Invoiced with thirty days to pay.

selfHost.name: Self-hosted
selfHost.description: The same source code, on your own infrastructure, free for good.

features.h1: The complete platform source, open under AGPL-3.0
features.h2: Every future update included, for good
features.h3: On your own infrastructure, with your own data
features.h4: No contract, no activation, no account with us
features.h5: Export your work from nisd2.eu and carry on running it yourself
features.h6: Direct contact by email and Signal
features.h7: Setup by us if you want it: 500 € net, one off

pricing.whyFree: Why self-hosting costs nothing: the source is on GitHub, inspectable and runnable by anyone. What is paid for is the guided pass and us running it, not the right to use the software.

guarantee.heading: Thirty days money back
guarantee.body: You get an invoice with thirty days to pay. If the pass turns out not to be for you in that time, say so and the invoice is cancelled. Whatever you signed off by then is yours and exports cleanly.

comparison.heading: Where that sits in the market
comparison.intro: Comparable offers for a company of 50 to 250 people, as of September 2026. Providers' own prices, not our estimate.

r1.note: Templates and checklists, no record of what was decided

r2.note: Guided pass, full decision trail, export at any time

r3.note: The software only works alongside a consultant

pricing.consultantFootnote: Stuck on NIS 2? Short factual questions cost nothing, and if you need a specialist firm we will introduce you to one at no cost to you.
